ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast (matrix) captures an inspired performance highlighted by a smoking The Other One → Cryptical Envelopment → Death Don't Have No Mercy sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording, taken from the original KPFA/KPFB live broadcast, is crystal‑clear with pleasant crowd ambience and delivers a superb listening experience. Musically the show shines especially in the second‑set medley of The Other One, Cryptical Envelopment and Death Don't Have No Mercy, where Jerry’s guitar is on fire and the twin drummers lock in tight. A few minor misfires on the Lovelight solo are noted but do not detract from an overall killer performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praising both the musical performance and recording quality; rating reflects exceptional show and excellent matrix source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear FM broadcast mix with strong board clarity and pleasant crowd ambience; no notable drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set medley flows exceptionally well, building intensity; overall performance is tight with only minor solo hiccups.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Exceptionally inspired guitar work throughout, delivering the goods continuously; a few misfires in the first Lovelight solo but otherwise stellar.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart and Bill Kreutzmann are described as 'in synch and on fire' during the performance.
